name: chemistry_et_raw_uniform
hypothesis: Fold-local experts on the fixed mutually exclusive cu_o, fe_anion, and other composition routes will reduce pooled OOF MAE by separating target relationships, while raw-target ExtraTrees will preserve positive-Tc and rare high-Tc predictions.
falsification: Falsified if pooled OOF MAE is not below G01's 7.9126834488 K or positive-Tc OOF MAE exceeds G01's 8.8321655079 K; high-Tc MAE and route behavior diagnose whether specialization merely overfits small groups.
